reuse.why: Five actions pass the flag to the existing shouldSetMonthBudget predicate, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own inline checks and gets its own copy of the include-hidden logic and #fixed regex instead of using that predicate.

duplication.why: The #fixed regex and the hidden/group-hidden exclusion now exist both in shouldSetMonthBudget and inline in copyPreviousMonth, and getBudgetData gains a second notes join mirroring getMonthActionCategories.

placement.why: The flag is handled in the shared predicate in budget/actions.ts for most actions; only copyPreviousMonth decides it locally.

scope.why: Focused on the flag, but also adds the #fixed exclusion to copyPreviousMonth, a behaviour change when the flag is absent that the request did not ask for.

maintainability.why: Any future change to the month-wide exclusion rules has to be mirrored in copyPreviousMonth's hand-written condition, which already differs in form (=== 1 vs === 0 checks).

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts re-implements the hidden/#fixed/template exclusions inline instead of calling shouldSetMonthBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth's condition restates shouldSetMonthBudget in negated, reordered form (`(!includeHiddenCategories && (hidden === 1 || group_hidden === 1)) || /#fixed/.test(...) || has_saved_templates === 1`) rather than calling it.
